description: Navigation between result pages, with current position and bounds.

howToUse: Use it below a list or table that shows one page of results at a time.
Pass the current `page` and the total `pageCount`, and load the new page in `onPageChange`.
After changing page, take the person back to the top of the list.
alternatives: A feed people scroll without counting pages: a "Load more" Button.
A table with built-in pages: the `pagination` of Table.

keyboard.action: Moves through previous, the page numbers and next.
Goes to the page in focus.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Visible neighbors on each side of the current page. Default 1.
